summary: Kanzhun Ltd filed a Form 6-K attaching a Next Day Disclosure Return for Hong Kong-listed equity, reporting multiple on-market share repurchases executed from March 20 to April 15, 2026. The buybacks involve small daily volumes (0.03-0.08% of outstanding shares) at prices ranging from approximately USD 6.57 to 7.14 per share. The shares are repurchased for cancellation but remain uncancelled as of the reporting date. This is a routine disclosure of an ongoing capital return program under HKEX rules, with no extraordinary terms or board recommendation. Watch for incremental buyback execution cadence; no risk-arb angle as it is not a tender offer.
